title: Blade Runner: More Human Than Human
description: Neon rain, folded-paper messages, and a question nobody agrees on—five steps into what makes us human.

questions.question: Which director followed up Alien with Blade Runner (1982)?
questions.explanation: The shoot got so tense that crew wore "Yes Guv'nor, My Ass" T-shirts after Scott praised British crews in an interview. His team answered with "Xenophobia Sucks" shirts.

questions.question: Scott's Blade Runner opens in Los Angeles in what year?
questions.explanation: The opening card reads "Los Angeles, November, 2019," so we have officially outlived Blade Runner's future, minus the flying Spinners and off-world colonies.

questions.question: In that 2019 Los Angeles, which ex-blade runner, played by Harrison Ford, is pulled back in to hunt replicants?
questions.explanation: He comes from Philip K. Dick's novel Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? Dick died months before the release but saw an early effects reel and was reportedly stunned.

questions.question: Replicants supposedly fail the Voight-Kampff empathy test, yet Roy Batty saves Deckard, then says his memories will be lost "like..." what?
questions.explanation: Rutger Hauer cut the scripted speech he called "opera talk" and wrote that line himself around 4 a.m. The machine built without feelings gets the film's most human moment.

questions.question: After Roy's tears in rain speech, Gaff leaves an origami figure outside Deckard's door, matching a daydream restored in the Director's Cut. What is it?
questions.explanation: Gaff folded a chicken and a matchstick man earlier. If he knows Deckard's private dream, it was implanted. Ford reportedly yelled, "I thought we said I wasn't a replicant!"

imageHint: Rain-slick streets and neon in a dystopian cityscape

easterEgg.title: The Blade Runner curse
easterEgg.text: Atari, Pan Am, and the Bell System all glowed on the film's skyline. Within a decade, Atari crashed, Pan Am folded, and Bell was broken up. Blade Runner 2049 put Atari and Pan Am back up anyway.
